rows.en: <operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Have you calmed down yet, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...Like I could calm down!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>That was some rampage, after all.
rows.notes: Source omits the subject (who went wild); kept subjectless.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>"You have seen military secrets. So you will be staying with the military for a while."
rows.notes: Barrel sarcastically quoting what the military told him; rendered as a quotation.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>"Fight for us while you're at it. We're short on pilots, and you have the aptitude."
rows.notes: Continuation of the quotation from text id 23.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...It'd be weirder NOT to go wild after hearing that. It's absurd.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>To begin with, the war was supposed to have ended ages ago, so why is an army like this still around?!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>And another thing! What on earth was that monster? Is that the so-called secret?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>... We don't know the details yet, either. The military is on the move to make that clear, too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But that's got nothing to do with me!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I'm sorry for dragging you into this... But right now, you're the only one I can ask.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>This machine can't bring out its true performance without two people aboard.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>It doesn't have to be me...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>When you were aboard, the <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()> showed combat ability above its rated specs.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>It's not only to protect the secret. You show promise as a fighter, so I had things arranged this way.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>That's only what suits you people...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, until Commander <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> hands down a decision, things will have to stay as they are.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I understand how you feel, but please try to keep your composure.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>For now, think of survival first. All units, support the <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()>.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>We know, we know. We're all in the same boat here, after all.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>At first, we and Captain <color(4)>Amuro<ce()> were forced into the military and made to fight, too. I know how you feel.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>So I wasn't the only one...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But I have no intention of fighting...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, think of it this way. Since you have to stay on this ship for a while, this is the safest option.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Because if we don't fight, the ship itself is in danger.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>A soldier would see it that way, sure, but...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>When you fight, someone's life gets saved, too. Remember that.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I used to rebel like that, too.
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>We of all people can understand how he feels. Let's back him up.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. But... I'm reluctant to fight them.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>The Zentradi, huh? And after we finally made peace, too.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Still...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I know. I can't be like this... Sorry.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>We've really settled into the military, haven't we?
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>We were scouted personally by the battle-hardened <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, after all.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Means we've got the air of aces about us now.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>All right, let's put on a big show again today, like the aces we are!

uncertainties.issue: Subject omitted in source (someone 'went wild a lot'); context = Barrel. Rendered subjectless: 'That was some rampage'.
'I had things arranged this way' - source has Faye having asked (someone) to set it up this way; agent of the arranging is unstated.
'-kun' on Barrel dropped. 'Commander Misumaru' used for the shirei title per brief.
'them' = the Zentradi per next row; Amuro's reluctance kept vague as in source.
Light's trailing 'desu ga...' rendered 'Still...'; he is about to object to Amuro's hesitation.

checked_decisions: 0/21 subjectless 'That was some rampage': source omits subject; context (Faye asking Barrel if he calmed down) settles Barrel, subjectless rendering is safe. Accepted.

0/22-23 rendered as quotation: speaker id is Barrel (1040) but the content is what the military told him ('kimi wa...'), and 0/24 '...sore de abarenai hou ga okashii' confirms he is quoting. Accepted.

0/33 'I had things arranged this way': '-te moratta' marks the speaker's side as the one who asked for/received the arrangement; 'I' vs 'we' is not settled by the source. Accepted, listed as remaining uncertainty.
0/35 '-kun' dropped, 'Commander Misumaru': matches 7 other corpus uses; glossary gives him as male admiral / Londo Bell commander. Accepted.
0/38 'same boat': source = 'same circumstances/background'; next row (Kaine: we and Amuro were forced in too) confirms the sense. Accepted.
1/61 'them' = Zentradi, confirmed by Light's next row. Accepted.
1/63 'Still...' for trailing 'desu ga...': Amuro's 'I know. I can't be like this' confirms Light was about to object. Accepted.
remaining_uncertainties: 0/33: whether Faye alone or Faye's side ('we') asked for the arrangement is not recoverable from the source; 'I' kept.
